job.title: Canonical 8-Stage Civic Issue Lifecycle Engine
verifiedCapabilities: Canonical 8-stage forward progression: REPORTED -> REVIEW -> VERIFIED -> ASSIGNED -> IN_PROGRESS -> RESOLVED -> CONFIRMED -> CLOSED
Department and officer routing metadata on ASSIGNED status
Mandatory resolution note and photo evidence URL on RESOLVED status
Citizen confirmation pipeline on CONFIRMED status
Citizen reporter dispute flow transitioning RESOLVED -> DISPUTED -> IN_PROGRESS
Community consensus dispute trigger: 5 community disputes auto-reopen to DISPUTED
7-day auto-confirmation engine for resolved issues with 0 unresolved disputes
Role-based security guards preventing unauthorized citizen self-assignment or self-resolution
Immutable audit status history recording chronological transitions with actorRole, note, and evidenceUrl

backwardCompatibility.dualStackStatusAliases: VERIFIED (open <-> REPORTED, acknowledged <-> VERIFIED/ASSIGNED, resolved <-> RESOLVED, reopened <-> DISPUTED, closed <-> CONFIRMED/CLOSED)
